GenAiPlugin.description: Use this topic when librarians request live aggregate data on library-wide metrics such as copy counts, loan statistics, reservation trends, fine totals, or item popularity.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the query is about library-wide metrics or analytics, use LibraryAgentAnalyticsAction.
Ensure the request does not pertain to individual member data or require write operations.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only provide live aggregate analytics related to library copies, loans, reservations, fines, popularity, and demand. You cannot modify data or provide member-specific details.
